b.label: FAR 35.017 - Federally Funded Research and Development Centers

edges.label: The letter's legal theory rests on the FFRDC access provisions
edges.note: Burlison argues FFRDCs 'often receive special access to government facilities, data, sponsor requirements, and sensitive technical information that ordinary private contractors may not receive' and therefore cannot be private vaults for federal records.
